rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for sand, including sand on beaches and sand used in construction.

example.english: The sand on the beach is really fine and feels good underfoot.
example.traditional: 沙灘啲沙好幼，踩落去好舒服。
example.jyutping: saa1 taan1 di1 saa1 hou2 jau3 caai2 lok6 heoi3 hou2 syu1 fuk6
